lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit. The spots are arranged in a regular grid-like pattern with the highest intensity clusters located on the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observable, intersecting with the primary horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like lattice across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a distinct light-to-dark vertical gradient (dorsal-to-ventral) creating a sharp linear feature.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits several high-luminance blobs, primarily distributed along the anterior-basal quadrant of the fin's macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of smaller, high-intensity punctate spots is visible on the leading edge and dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin.
